newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam sells 70 bln dong T-notes, rate 8.30 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam sells 70 bln dong T-notes, rate 8.30 pct.

text.p: Vietnam sold 70 billion dong ($6.35 million) worth of one-year Treasury notes with an annual coupon of 8.30 percent at an auction on Wednesday, an official at the State Bank of Vietnam said.
At the last auction of government paper, on September 11, the central bank issued 50 billion dong worth of one-year notes at a rate of 8.47 percent.
The issue date of the notes sold on Wednesday is September 27 and maturity will be on September 27, 1997.
The bank said allotments, in dong, were as follows:
Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam (Vietcombank) 23.1 billion
Phuong Nam Commercial Joint-Stock Bank 5.0 billion
Tan Viet Commercial Joint-Stock Bank 3.2 billion
Technical and Commerce Commercial Joint-Stock Bank 3.1 billion
